title: South Lake Tahoe Parasailing
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
An individual must weigh at least 40 lbs and no more than 300 lbs to participate
A minimum of 2 people are needed to book this product
Parasailing is done in tandem; singles may be paired with another person or two depending on weight
*Customers must call local supplier to set up parasailing time at least 24 hours in advance (subject to availability).
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: Enjoy fantastic views of Lake Tahoe from the air as you soar hundreds of feet above the surface of the water! On a parasailing ride from South Lake Tahoe, fly like a bird above the lake at a height of 500 feet (152 meters) above Lake Tahoe behind 1000' of line. With an experienced crew, you’ll enjoy an exhilarating and safe experience as you gaze down on Lake Tahoe’s crystal-clear waters.
